meta.simulator: scratchpad/stocksim (read-only port of Bitburner v3.0.1 StockMarket)
meta.methodology: k = guaranteed-successful influence events/tick, applied via a fractional accumulator (acc+=k; while(acc>=1){influenceHack/Grow(sym,1.0); acc-=1}) so fractional k spreads deterministically across ticks. Each event still consumes one RNG draw (fraction=1.0 always succeeds), matching influenceStockThroughServerHack/Grow always calling Math.random() first.
